t.en: In this section, we will use elementary matrices to prove a useful theorem about the inverse of a square matrix. We start with an observation about the echelon form of a right invertible matrix.
t.zh: 这一节我们用初等矩阵来证明一个关于方阵的逆的有用定理。先从一个关于右可逆矩阵的行阶梯形的观察开始。

title.en: Echelon form of a right invertible matrix
title.zh: 右可逆矩阵的行阶梯形

t.en: Suppose that $A$ is right invertible. Then the reduced echelon form of $A$ does not have a row of zeros.
t.zh: 设 $A$ 是右可逆的。那么 $A$ 的简化行阶梯形不含零行。

t.en: If $R$ had a row of zeros, then so would the product $R(BU^{-1})$. But since the identity matrix $I$ does not have a row of zeros, neither does $R$.
t.zh: 如果 $R$ 含有零行，那么乘积 $R(BU^{-1})$ 也含有零行。但单位矩阵 $I$ 不含零行，所以 $R$ 也不含零行。

title.en: Right invertible square matrices are invertible
title.zh: 右可逆的方阵是可逆的

t.en: Suppose $A$ and $B$ are square matrices such that $AB=I$. Then it follows that $BA=I$, and therefore $B=A^{-1}$. In particular, a square matrix is right invertible if and only if it is left invertible if and only if it is invertible.
t.zh: 设 $A$ 和 $B$ 是方阵，且 $AB=I$。那么 $BA=I$，从而 $B=A^{-1}$。特别地，方阵右可逆，当且仅当它左可逆，当且仅当它可逆。

t.en: Assume $A$ and $B$ are square matrices such that $AB=I$. Let $R$ be the reduced echelon form of $A$. Then by Theorem “The form $R=UA$”, we can write $R=UA$ where $U$ is an invertible matrix. Since $AB=I$, we know by Lemma “Echelon form of a right invertible matrix” that $R$ does not have a row of zeros. Since $R$ is a square reduced echelon form with no row of zeros, each column must be a pivot column, and it follows that $R=I$. Hence, $UA=I$, and therefore $A$ is left invertible. Moreover, we have
t.zh: 设 $A$ 和 $B$ 是方阵，且 $AB=I$。设 $R$ 是 $A$ 的简化行阶梯形。由定理“$R=UA$ 的形式”，可以写出 $R=UA$，其中 $U$ 是可逆矩阵。因为 $AB=I$，由引理“右可逆矩阵的行阶梯形”知 $R$ 不含零行。又因为 $R$ 是不含零行的方阵简化行阶梯形，所以每一列都是主元列，于是 $R=I$。因此 $UA=I$，即 $A$ 是左可逆的。此外，我们有

t.en: and therefore $B=U$. It follows that $BA=UA=I$, as claimed.
t.zh: 所以 $B=U$。由此 $BA=UA=I$，这就是要证明的。

t.en: To prove the last claim, note that we just proved that for square matrices, $AB=I$ implies $BA=I$. Therefore, every right inverse of $A$ is also a left inverse, and therefore an inverse. But of course, we also have that $BA=I$ implies $AB=I$. This is just the same theorem, with the roles of $A$ and $B$ interchanged. Therefore, every left inverse of $A$ is also a right inverse.
t.zh: 为证明最后一个结论，注意我们刚刚证明了：对方阵来说，$AB=I$ 推出 $BA=I$。因此，$A$ 的每个右逆也是左逆，从而是逆。当然，反过来 $BA=I$ 也推出 $AB=I$：这就是同一个定理，只是把 $A$ 与 $B$ 的角色互换。因此，$A$ 的每个左逆也是右逆。

t.en: This theorem is very useful, because it allows us to test only one of the products $AB$ or $BA$ in order to check that $B$ is the inverse of $A$, saving us half of the work. It is important to stress, however, that this only works for *square* matrices. As we saw in Example “Right inverse”, non-square matrices can be right invertible without being left invertible, or vice versa.
t.zh: 这个定理非常有用，因为要验证 $B$ 是 $A$ 的逆，只需检验乘积 $AB$ 与 $BA$ 中的一个，省去一半的工作。不过要强调的是，这只对*方*阵成立。正如我们在例“右逆”中看到的，非方阵可以右可逆而不左可逆，反之亦然。
